adds.title: Court of Justice of Sergipe announcement 28 August 2025
adds.summary: As of 28 August 2025 the Sergipe Court of Justice provides operating gender-neutral bathrooms on the ground, 1st and 8th floors of the Palácio da Justiça in Aracaju usable by any person regardless of gender identity to guarantee a safe inclusive sanitary environment for non-binary, transgender and other gender identities, mandates that in all Sergipe judiciary units male and female bathrooms be used respecting each person's gender identity under human-rights and non-discrimination principles, and plans all new constructions and renovations with gender-equity demands.

adds.title: Federal University of Sergipe decision 17 November 2025
adds.summary: On 17 November 2025, the Federal University of Sergipe created quotas for trans people in undergraduate courses.

adds.title: Bill by state representative Rodrigo Valadares (UNIÃO) 1 December 2020
adds.summary: On 1 December 2020 Sergipe state deputy Rodrigo Valadares tabled a bill to prohibit the use and teaching of gender-neutral language in Sergipe's public and private schools and in state public offices, requiring traditional Portuguese in schools, official notices and public offices, thereby blocking a form advocated to reduce gender discrimination and include agender and non-binary people.

adds.title: Supreme Federal Court of Brazil - 1 March 2018 ruling on gender identity
adds.summary: On 1 March 2018 in ADI 4275 the Plenary of the Supreme Federal Court held that the right to equality without discrimination encompasses gender identity and expression and that travestis, transexual and transgender persons may obtain alteration of name and gender on the civil registry without sex-reassignment surgery or judicial authorization, because gender identity is a manifestation of personality that the State must recognize.

adds.title: Public Defender's Office of Tocantins - August 2022 request to General Inspectorate of Justice
adds.summary: In August 2022 the Tocantins Public Defender's Office requested the state General Inspectorate of Justice to allow inclusion of non-binary gender in civil registry records.

adds.title: General Inspectorate of Justice of Tocantins - 2023 resolution on non-binary gender marker
adds.summary: On 31 January 2023 the Corregedoria-Geral da Justiça of Tocantins issued Provimento No. 3 consolidating extrajudicial service norms, providing civil-registry procedures for birth registration with a transgender parent and for averbação of altered prenome and sex for transgender and non-binary persons.

adds.title: Public Defender's Office of Tocantins - 29 January 2026 article on National Trans Visibility Day
adds.summary: In Tocantins, trans men, trans women, non-binary, queer and travesti persons may request administrative rectification of name and/or gender marker at the civil registry where birth was registered with full legal effect in birth certificate and all official documents based solely on gender self-determination without medical or psychological reports or proof of surgery or hormonal treatment under the Federal Supreme Court understanding since 2018 and National Council of Justice norms, free upon proof of inability to pay with judicial recourse only if denied, except rectification to non-binary or unspecified gender which requires a judicial decision.
